name: 993 oval exhaust tip, IN625 double wall (PicoGK)
picogk_enhancement: Bionic (IN625): the legacy wetted bore (slip bore and smoothstep round-to-oval loft of oval_exhaust_tip) is kept exactly with a single inner_wall_mm flow shell, an exact collar_wall_mm slip / clamp collar and a closed outlet lip out to the published 120 x 85 mm outlet; the ventilated outer shell and its eight fixed radial ribs are replaced by stiffeners grown by 3D SIMP topology optimization (bionic.json, topopt.py) between the flow shell and the outlet envelope: hoop frames across the broad faces, ribs on the narrow faces and a branching buttress into the collar. Shell, collar and lip enter the optimization as analysis_only solids (shell stiffness wall / element) and are printed exactly. Assumed loads: screening mass x 20 g across, along the major axis and axially (plus the screen's 77.6 N axial pressure force), and the screen's 30 kPa gauge pressure on the flare walls (ovalization), collar clamped. Loads are assumptions until measured; thermal growth is not a SIMP load.

length_mm.note: same concept length as the build123d F0/F1

collar_wall_mm.note: bionic: slip / clamp collar wall over the slip depth (inner wall + 1.5 mm clamp seat); clamp not measured

outer_wall_mm.note: LPBF Ti minimum robust wall; bionic: only sets the legacy bore size

gap_mm.note: same 2.7 mm annular channel as the F1; bionic: only sets the legacy bore size (no annular channel)

outlet_lip_mm.note: closed outlet lip, axial length (bionic: exact ring from the flow shell to the outlet envelope)

rib_count.note: legacy radial ribs tying the walls; not used by the bionic layout (ribs are grown by topopt.py)

rib_thickness_mm.note: legacy rib thickness; not used by the bionic layout

open_interfaces: tip orientation / angle cut on the car
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file
